typography.notes: No Inter or Roboto. Use tracking-tighter for H1 and H2. Font pairings must scream premium and technical authority, much like Apple or Tesla brand identities.

colors.notes: Bright white base. Premium blue accents ONLY. Absolutely NO purple or violet AI-slop gradients.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use sparingly on sticky headers and floating elements: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/20 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)]
visual_enhancers.rounded_corners: Premium smooth corners using rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for cards and media.
visual_enhancers.textures: Minimal clean surfaces, relying on sharp drop shadows and precise spacing to create depth rather than muddy textures.

motion.hero_animation: Kinetic hero with a signature on-load moment (masked line-by-line reveal for 'Premium Air Conditioning').
motion.scroll_reveals: Subtle translate-y and opacity fades triggered by scroll.
motion.parallax: Include one subtle parallax or 3D hero moment using framer-motion useScroll.

layouts.hero: Awwwards-level kinetic typography headline 'Premium Air Conditioning'. Highly minimal layout focusing on line-by-line text reveal, combined with a subtle parallax image of a premium HVAC setup or Australian home.
layouts.services_grid: Bento grid protocol (md:grid-cols-3) with wide gap-8. Each card features large minimalist typography and a crisp icon. Hover causes a subtle lift and blue accent border reveal.
layouts.brands_marquee: One ultra-smooth, slow editorial marquee featuring crisp, high-contrast monochrome logos.
layouts.about_manifesto: Numbered chapters (e.g., '01', '02' in large display font). Asymmetrical layout avoiding standard alternating left/right blocks. Focus on emotional, brand-driven storytelling.
layouts.gallery: Clipping frames/spotlights treating real product photography and homes like high-end art installations. Hover expands the clipped mask slightly.
layouts.reviews: Carousel with glassmorphic cards and crisp 5-star graphics, relying on framer-motion drag or Swiper.
layouts.service_areas: Sleek, minimalist accordion or tabular list. No clutter.
layouts.faq: Shadcn accordion with large tap targets and plus/minus icons that rotate cleanly on open.
layouts.contact: GoHighLevel compatible form layout. Inputs for: Name, Phone, Service, Suburb. NO EMAIL ADDRESS FIELD. Sticky 'Call Now' CTA prominently featuring phone 0414 698 435.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary: Solid premium blue bg-[#0055FF] hover:bg-[#002244] text-white with smooth transform scale interactions.
components.cards: Subtle shadows shadow-sm, 1px border-slate-100, white background, generous padding (p-8 to p-12).
components.forms: Use Shadcn components. Clean 1px solid borders focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0055FF]. Very large accessible inputs (h-14).

White and black lighted concrete modern house

hvac_technicians.description: Skilled technician working on maintenance indoors

Clean white tiled living room with AC

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG contrast compliance. Dark slate text (#0A0A0A) on bright backgrounds.
accessibility.focus_states: High contrast focus rings (ring-2 ring-[#0055FF] ring-offset-2).
accessibility.data_testid: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: framer-motion, @studio-freight/react-lenis, react-fast-marquee, lucide-react.
Implement Lenis at the root layout for smooth momentum scrolling across the entire app.
Build a 'Kinetic Hero' with a masked line-by-line reveal using framer-motion (overflow-hidden wrapper, text animating from y: '100%' to '0%').
Implement a slow, editorial logo marquee for Brands (Daikin, Mitsubishi Electric, Fujitsu, Panasonic, Rinnai).
Create a 'Manifesto' section with an asymmetrical layout and oversized chapter numbers ('01', '02').
Add a sticky Call CTA for mobile and desktop linking to 'tel:0414698435'.
DO NOT include an email field in the Contact Form or display an email address ANYWHERE on the site.
The Contact form must only collect: Name, Phone, Service, Suburb.
Use bright white backgrounds (#FFFFFF) with premium blue accents (#0055FF). Absolutely NO purple/violet gradients.
Apply generous internal padding (p-12 to p-24) to establish a luxury, breathing layout.
Use glassmorphism (bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl) for sticky navigational elements only, do NOT use 100% transparent backgrounds for headers over content.
Display Business ABN: 62 137 127 557 in the footer.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients. Prioritize optical alignment.
Create depth through layered design elements with precise z-index hierarchy and subtle ambient shadows.
Use high-end glass-morphism effects with strong backdrop filters (12-24px blur) combined with saturation boosts (saturate-150).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions ONLY for specific interactive properties (transform, opacity).
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped) with interaction micro-animations (e.g., scale 0.98 on tap).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons. Use Phosphor or Lucide icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='submit-quote-btn'`).
Use sonner for toasts, customized to match the Apple-inspired stark UI.
